buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 1. The rates of minimum wages are based on the revised order of the office of the Deputy Co mmissioner, Chandigarh, order No. DC/DN/2026/2428-2435 dated 12.05.2026 which ar e subject to revision from time to time. 2. The bidder must have its Registered and Head Office located in Chandigarh. To support this claim, the bidder shall be required to submit valid documentary proof such as the Sho p Act Registration Certificate, GST Registration Certificate, etc., clearly indicatin g the Chandigarh address. 3. The EPF and ESI registration certificates submitted by the bidder must clearly ref lect the Chandigarh jurisdiction. This is to ensure smooth and uninterrupted handling o f all EPF and ESI related matters for the manpower deployed, without any administrative or procedural hindrances in future. 4. All bidders, while participating in the bid, must submit a detailed itemized billing structure mentioning the percentage-wise breakup of components such as EPF, ESI, service charges, etc. A sample invoice on the bidder’s letterhead must also be uploaded, clearly in dicating both the monthly value and the total value of the contract. This document must be uploaded only under the 'Financial Documents/Price Breakup' section of th e bid. Submissions made elsewhere shall not be considered during evaluation. 5. Bids offering rates lower than the minimum wages notified by the Deputy Commissioner, C handigarh, for the relevant category will be rejected. 6. The bidder must be registered with the appropriate statutory authorities. Valid registration certificates from the Labour Department, ESIC, and EPF must be uploaded, along with copies of EPF and ESI returns for the last three months. 7. The bidder must be registered with the Income Tax and GST departments and must have v alid PAN and GST numbers. ITRs and GST Annual Returns for the last three financial years must be uploaded. 8. The bidder must possess at least two satisfactory completion certificates for works of simil ar nature/category as specified in the bid, each having a value of more than ₹20,00,000/-. 9. The bidder should have experience of at least 10 continuous years or more in provi ding Manpower Services to the Income Tax/ GST Department. 10. The bidder must have completed at least two contracts, each of a value not less tha n ₹1 crore, related to similar services within the last three years. 11. The bidder must not have been blacklisted on GeM for providing manpower services. 12. The bidder must submit documentary evidence showing a minimum turnover of more than ₹7 crores in at least one of the last three financial years.

13. The bidder must possess a valid ISO 9001:2015 Certificate for Quality Management System s. 14. The bidder must be registered with the MSME Department for providing the required servic es and relevant documents in support uploaded. 15. Preference will be given to bidders who have previously worked with the Income Tax Department. Relevant documentary evidence must be uploaded in the ATC. 16. Each bidder is required to submit an undertaking on bidder’s letter head duly signed by the bidder that:- a. That the documents submitted by the agency are genuine and undisputable and i n the event of it coming to notice at a later date that the documents are not gen uine, bidder shall be liable for legal action and such compensation payable to De partment as may be decided by the Department. b. That the bidder has no dispute with any of the Govt. Deptts./ Govt. institutions et c. regarding any tender/ work supply of manpower etc. c. That there is no complaint against the bidder. If the bidder is involved in any litig ation, it must mention the same in its bid. The bidder has not been blacklisted, a nd no penalty or punishment of any type has been imposed on it by any of the G ovt. Deptts./ Govt. Institutions etc. d. That the bidder will not sublet the work (if awarded to his /their company) and if done so, penalty shall be payable by his/ their company to the Department as m ay be decided by the Department. 17. The Buyer reserves the absolute right to cancel the bid at any stage without assigning any reason whatsoever. The Buyer also reserves the right to reject any bidder at its sole discret ion based on internal assessment and analysis, without being liable to provide justification. 18. In case any manpower is already deployed at the Buyer/Consignee’s location, the successf ul bidder shall not have the right to remove or replace such manpower after award of the c ontract. Any replacement, if deemed absolutely necessary due to unavoidable circumstanc es, shall be carried out only with the prior written approval of the Buyer. Unauthorized re moval or replacement of manpower shall result in immediate termination of the contract without any liability on the part of the Buyer. Further, each bidder shall be required to upload an Undertaking on its official letterhead, duly signed and stamped, speci fically confirming compliance with this condition. The format of undertaking is given below: - We, M/s ___________________________, having our registered office at _________________ ___________, hereby solemnly undertake and agree as under:

(a) That in the event of award of contract, we shall not remove or replace any manpo wer already deployed at the Buyer/Consignee’s location without obtaining prior w ritten approval from the Buyer. (b) That we fully understand and accept that any unauthorized removal or replacem ent of manpower shall amount to a violation of the contract terms and may lead t o imposition of penalties and termination of the contract at the discretion of t he Buyer. (c) That we shall remain bound by the above condition during the entire tenure of th e contract. Date: ___________ Place: __________ (Signature with Seal) Authorized Signatory M/s ___________________________ 19. All bidders are requested to upload the documents mentioned in this ATC strictly in the ATC and Additional Documents sections of the bid. It is advised that the documents specifi cally required under the ATC should be uploaded preferably in the ATC section o nly, to ensure easy verification during evaluation. The buyer reserves the right to reject the bid in case the required documents/certificates are not uploaded as in structed. .
